svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Страница-1" id="2mv9DF1Mri43-vEEGVJH"> <mxGraphModel dx="2060" dy="1316" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: Схема функциональности
---

sequenceDiagram
 actor User
 participant Main as main
 participant UI as ConsolePresenter
 participant Game as ChessGame
 participant HP as HumanPlayer
 participant Input as ConsolePlayerInput
 participant AP as AIPlayer
 participant Strat as MinimaxAlphaBetaStrategy
 participant Board as Board

 rect rgb(230, 245, 255)
 Note over Main,Board: 1. Initialization
 Main->>HP: create HumanPlayer + ConsolePlayerInput
 Main->>AP: create AIPlayer + MinimaxAlphaBetaStrategy
 Main->>Game: ChessGame(white, black)
 Main->>Game: setUiCallbacks(callbacks)
 Main->>UI: printBoard(board)
 end

 rect rgb(232, 255, 232)
 Note over Main,Board: 2. Human move
 Main->>UI: printTurnHeader(white)
 Main->>Game: playTurn()
 Game->>HP: requestMove(board, move)
 HP->>Input: readMove(board, color, move)
 Input-->>User: e2 e4
 Game->>Board: isLegalMove(move)
 Game->>Board: makeMove(move)
 end

 rect rgb(255, 245, 230)
 Note over Main,Board: 3. AI move
 Main->>UI: printTurnHeader(black)
 Main->>Game: playTurn()
 Game->>AP: requestMove(board, move)
 AP->>Strat: chooseMove(board, aiColor, move)
 Strat->>Board: minimax search on board
 Game->>Board: isLegalMove(move)
 Game->>Board: makeMove(move)
 end

 rect rgb(245, 232, 255)
 Note over Main,Board: 4. End of game
 Main->>Game: isGameOver()
 Game-->>Main: true
 Main->>UI: printTurnResult(last result)
 Main->>UI: printBoard(board)
 Main->>UI: printHistory(history)
 end
",
 "config": null
}" id="Awoo2QrTATK8I5eAUu8a-203"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;imageAspect=1;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1820" width="2217.5" x="770" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
